officialText:
Enactment date: 6/27/2025

Int. No. 1037-A

By Council Members Nurse, Restler, Cabán, Ossé, Avilés, Sanchez, Brooks-Powers, Gutiérrez, Hudson, Banks, Hanif, Abreu, Marte, Riley, Bottcher, Banks, Won, Williams, Krishnan, De La Rosa, Feliz, Ayala, Schulman, Brewer, Louis, Lee, Rivera, Mealy and the Public Advocate (Mr. Williams)

A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to posting certain information in multiple dwellings containing rent stabilized units

Be it enacted by the Council as follows:

* * *

[Consolidated provisions are not included in this Appendix A]

* * *

§ 2. Prior to the effective date of section one this local law, the department of housing preservation and development shall execute an agreement with the New York state division of housing and community renewal to use data regarding the rent stabilization status of a building for the purposes of enforcing subdivision b of section 27-2104 of the administrative code of the city of New York, as added by section one of such local law.

§ 3. This local law takes effect 210 days after it becomes law, except that section two of this local law takes effect immediately.
